name: Excalibur Unleashed

features.name: Wild reels
features.description: Wilds on reel 1 or 5 unlock a wild reel with a random multiplier.

features.name: Sticky in free spins

features.name: Growing multipliers
features.description: Each win adds 1x to the sticky reel's multiplier.

review:
Animal heroes, crowns and crystal balls. Wilds landing on the first or fifth reel unlock a full wild reel with a random multiplier, which can make big line wins.

In free spins, those wild reels stick, and their multiplier goes up by 1x every time they're part of a win. That steady build is how the 5,000x max becomes reachable, and it makes the bonus feel like it's going somewhere. 96.05% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
